subject: rc
title: RC.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-18 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two), second of two on book p162, paired with v2-p162-1. Continues the education argument by holding race as concept against progressional-continuance — the question of whether race-thinking can be reconciled with real cultural continuance. (C)RC (the concept of race) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what race-as-concept produces when crossed with progressional-continuance — under conditions where narrow information lines sustain the present situation. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) branches from the main line to the upper left and carries ATTN (attraction). PROG-CONT sits at the upper-center. INFO-DY (information dynamics) anchors the upper-right output. RE-ST (restructuralism) sits below the central axis; its line carries INFO-DY and STY. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) form the lower-right output cluster. STY (style) hangs on the lower-left margin and carries IST-PT. INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality) anchors the lower-center, on a line from IST-PT. IST-PT (isolated particulars) anchors the bottom-center.
